attributes.board_name: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) – Speech-Language Pathologists and Audiologists program

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses from providers approved by ASHA, the Texas Speech-Language-Hearing Association (TSHA), the American Academy of Audiology (AAA) or the Texas Academy of Audiology (TAA). 1 CEU = 10 clock hours.
rules.carryover: Up to 10 extra clock hours (2 of them may be ethics) may be carried to the next renewal period; dual licensees up to 15.
rules.audit_note: Automated CE audit after renewal: a random sample must submit certificates, transcripts or other proof for the latest renewal period. Keep CE records at least 3 years.

topics.who: All SLPs and audiologists (0.2 CEU), within the 20 hours; also 2 hours for dual licensees
All licensees: HHSC-approved human trafficking prevention training must be completed to renew

rules.legal_basis: 16 Tex. Admin. Code ch. 111, Subchapter N (continuing professional education); Tex. Occ. Code ch. 51 and ch. 401; Occ. Code ch. 116
rules.notes: 20 clock hours (2.0 CEUs) per 2-year license, incl. 2 hours ethics. Dual SLP + audiology license: 30 clock hours (3.0 CEUs), incl. 2 hours ethics. All CE must be completed before the license expiration date to avoid a late fee. Licenses are issued for 2 years. Chapter 111 amendments effective Dec 1, 2025 and Sep 1, 2026 did not change the CE sections.
rules.rule_quote: Speech-language pathologists are required to obtain 20 clock hours of continuing education (2 continuing education units), with 2 clock hours (0.2 continuing education units) in ethics.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses from providers approved by ASHA, TSHA, AAA or TAA. 1 CEU = 10 clock hours.
rules.carryover: Up to 10 extra clock hours (2 of them may be ethics) may be carried to the next renewal period.
rules.audit_note: Random CE audit after renewal; keep records at least 3 years.

topics.who: Assistants in speech-language pathology and in audiology (0.2 CEU), within the 20 hours
HHSC-approved human trafficking prevention training must be completed to renew

rules.legal_basis: 16 Tex. Admin. Code ch. 111, Subchapter N; Tex. Occ. Code ch. 51 and ch. 401
rules.notes: Same 20 clock hours (2.0 CEUs) incl. 2 hours ethics as fully licensed SLPs and audiologists. Assistant licenses are issued for 2 years.
rules.rule_quote: An assistant in speech-language pathology is required to obtain 20 clock hours of continuing education (2 continuing education units), with 2 clock hours (0.2 continuing education units) in ethics.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses from providers approved by ASHA, TSHA, AAA or TAA. 1 CEU = 10 clock hours.
rules.legal_basis: 16 Tex. Admin. Code ch. 111, Subchapter N
rules.notes: Intern licenses are valid for one year: 10 clock hours (1.0 CEU) incl. 1 hour ethics. The intern in audiology license is exempt from CE.
rules.rule_quote: An intern in speech-language pathology is required to obtain 10 clock hours of continuing education (1 continuing education units), with 1 clock hour (0.1 continuing education units) in ethics.
